bone_rotation_continuity.metric: Quaternion geodesic angle 2*arccos(|<q_f, q_{f-1}>|) in degrees with q ~ -q equivalence

support_foot_and_contact_lifecycle.swing_toe_box_geometry_note: During stance, Foot_L and Foot_R mesh min_z stay within [-0.000029m, +0.000003m] (zero penetration, zero lift). At the first/last frame of swing (s=1/N or (N-1)/N), frozen StartStopWalkAction (src/motion/framework.py:661) applies linear-onset toe pitch (-12 deg * sin(pi*s)) while vertical lift uses quadratic-onset sin^2(pi*s), causing the front bottom edge of the 0.22m unrounded Foot box (+0.15m ahead of ankle) to dip to -0.002057m (L) and -0.002598m (R) while the ankle joint itself remains above ANKLE_REST_Z (0.070m).

com_and_rigid_body_geometry.physical_semantics_boundary: Whole-body CoM trajectory is kinematic mass-weighted telemetry computed from evaluated 15-segment pose bones (DEMPSTER_WINTER_15_SEGMENT_MODEL) and is NOT claimed as closed-loop dynamic balance or ground reaction force proof.

geometric_contact.physical_semantics_boundary: Geometric contact (contact_model.py + foot_contact.py) enforces kinematic anchor pinning, normal gap/penetration, and tangential slip checks in meters; dynamic reaction forces (N) belong exclusively to contact_force_solver.py / forward_dynamics.py.
